answer_1.quote: We argue that establishing trust requires rethinking every facet of this framework...

answer_2.quote: Many recent efforts have followed the traditional NLP evaluation paradigm and summarized LLM performance into evaluation metrics across existing benchmark datasets.

answer_3.quote: We advocate that now is the time to treat trust as a first‑class citizen and place it at the center of model development and evaluation.

answer_4.quote: While such controlled studies using human feedback are cost and time intensive, the minimum viable alternative for establishing trust may simply be the publication of a model's input‑output history.
